fact: Maroc Telecom's 5,700 km transafrican terrestrial cable from Morocco to Niger via Mauritania, Mali and Burkina Faso, recorded as completed in 2022, lets Moov Africa Niger connect to international bandwidth via the Maroc Telecom network (deal record for the e& financing; the record's own 'Connects to submarine cable at CIV and TGO' note is not a Niger landing).

fact: Algeria's APS account says the official launch of operation of the trans-Saharan fibre backbone linking In Guezzam (Algeria) to the Arlit-Agadez region (Niger) was held at Assamaka on 6 October 2026, with capacity up to 100 Gbps from the start, built by Algerie Telecom and Niger Telecom; the document describes it as carrying data traffic between the two countries and does not say that Niger's international traffic runs over it.

Niger's ANP reports that Niger's and Algeria's ministers presided on 6 October 2026 at Assamaka over the official launch of operation of the trans-Saharan fibre backbone linking Niger to Algeria; it gives no capacity and does not say that Niger's international traffic runs over it.
